Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Nagpur Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Executive post at IIM Nagpur is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation in any discipline with first class or its equivalent grade. A Post-Graduation with at least 50% marks is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Specific age relaxations may apply as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Executive post at IIM Nagpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIM Nagpur Junior Executive recruitment is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Executive position will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum experience required for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 05 years of post-qualification experience in academic or administrative activities is required.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Nagpur (IIM Nagpur).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.
